    1. sign(byte[])

Interface HttpSigner

All Known Implementing Classes:
JoseHttpSigner
public interface HttpSigner
The interface that signature signers must implement.

The sign method of the SignatureBase class requires an instance that implements this HttpSigner interface.

See Also:
  • RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures, Section 3.1. Creating a Signature
